newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Monday were at a standstill, with no reported trades, market sources said.
There were a few bids at $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis that were passed by owners pricing cattle at $112.00, market sources said.
The bulk of last week's sales were at $110.00, with a few at $109.00 on Friday. On a live basis, cattle were bid $67.00 but passed by owners asking $70.00.
This week's showlist was seen near last week's estimated 68,000 head, the sources said.
